facts.business: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Limited operates luxury hotels and resorts under The Leela brand across India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Term loan for acquisition and refurbishment of hotel properties
Lease Rental Discounting facility for Galleria office acquisition in Bangalore

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Impairment assessment of goodwill due to significant judgments and estimates in cash flow forecasts including projected EBITDA, revenue growth rates, and cost assumptions.

key_risks: Impairment risk of goodwill due to significant judgments in cash flow forecasts
Regulatory and tax compliance risks (GST penalties)
High leverage with secured debt against hotel assets and brand
facts.related_party_note: Multiple related party transactions including co-borrower arrangements with Schloss Chennai Private Limited, Schloss Chanakya Private Limited, Schloss Udaipur Private Limited, Schloss HMA Private Limited, and Leela Agra Resorts Limited; guarantees from Project Ballet Bangalore Holdings (DIFC) Private Limited and BSREP III India Ballet Holdings (DIFC) Limited; cross-utilization of capex limits among group entities.
